cues: About twenty one thousandths of a second.
Now take away one fatty wrapping around the nerve fibres, and the same reflex would take three and a half seconds.
Long enough for the thorn to go deep.
That wrapping is a tissue, and by the end of this lesson you will be able to calculate both numbers yourself.
